explanation: The theorem says that entry (i, j) of scalar(c) * g equals c times entry (i, j) of g, for g in GL (Fin 2) R. I read Mathlib's GeneralLinearGroup/Defs.lean and found only `coe_scalar` (the coercion of `scalar n u` is `Matrix.scalar n u.1`) and `scalar_commute`. I also grepped for `scalar_apply`, `scalar_mul` and `smul_eq_diagonal_mul` across Mathlib. Those only supply the building blocks `Matrix.scalar_apply` and `Matrix.smul_eq_diagonal_mul`, which this proof already uses. I found no single declaration giving the entrywise formula for a scalar unit times a GL element. Getting it from Mathlib would take several rewrites (`Units.val_mul`, `coe_scalar`, `scalar_apply`, `smul_eq_diagonal_mul`, `smul_apply`), which is more than one or two lines.
